design_brief_zh: 主卖点为铝合金拉杆及其三档调节、可折叠手机支架，同时按用户定向补充展示四个可挂挂钩和一个可折叠水杯支架。PC端采用顶部居中标题与支持说明，中部展示旅行箱后侧偏三分之四视角，拉杆升起并清晰呈现三档位置；左侧证据框连接拉杆及四个挂钩，右侧证据框连接折叠水杯支架。移动端将产品置于上半区，标题和支持说明置于产品上方，底部左右分别放置挂钩与水杯架说明，保持标题→支持说明→细节1→细节2阅读顺序。产品使用银灰或枪灰中性色硬壳竖纹外观，采用柔和自然侧光，突出铝合金拉杆、金属边框和部件轮廓；背景使用低饱和欧洲现代旅行场景，橙色仅作小面积强调。字体使用Arial、Helvetica或Amazon Ember风格无衬线字体，标题加粗，德语预留扩展空间。所有引线必须指向真实部件，禁止虚构手机支架、挂钩或杯架的具体形状、位置、尺寸和承重；若实拍无法同时展示四个挂钩与杯架，应使用真实局部特写或结构示意，不添加未经验证的性能描述。
compliance_note_zh: 文案仅使用已提供的铝合金拉杆、三档调节、可折叠手机支架、四个侧面挂钩和一个可折叠水杯架事实。不得将整只箱体描述为全铝，不得添加承重、耐用测试、兼容尺寸、认证、静音、官方背书或绝对化性能。四个挂钩和杯架必须以真实产品结构呈现；若图像无法验证其完整数量或位置，应先取得对应实拍，不得凭空绘制。
image_prompt_en: Create a premium Amazon A+ detail module for a YWJ 13A travel suitcase, square composition, with a clean European modern travel aesthetic, low-saturation silver and gunmetal palette, warm natural side lighting, subtle #01447B accents, and no rendered text. PC layout: centered title area at the top, centered supporting area beneath, suitcase in the middle-right at a three-quarter rear-side angle with the telescopic handle raised, and two precise detail callouts: left callout to the three handle positions and four side hanging hooks, right callout to the foldable cup holder; show the foldable phone holder integrated into the handle without making it the dominant feature. Use realistic product photography and macro insets, preserving visible vertical shell ridges, metallic frame, handle, hooks, and cup holder. Mobile layout: product and detail scenes in the upper half, text-safe empty space above, two separated detail areas below for hooks and cup holder; keep all callout lines outside text regions. Show exactly four usable side hooks and one foldable cup holder only if supported by the reference product imagery. No invented parts, no extra accessories, no logos, no competitor branding, no badges, no certifications, no performance claims, and absolutely no rendered text anywhere in the image.
